photo_alt: Engin on a boat, looking out over the sea.
body:
I'm Engin. I studied electronics engineering, went through a machine learning and deep learning phase, and these days I write backend systems at [Digital Loop](https://digital-loop.com).

Outside work I build whatever the week's curiosity points at: reverse engineering a device to see what it says over the wire, a driver for hardware that never got a proper one, keyboard firmware, a small game, a site that generates itself from event data.

I also make music. I DJ as **Balgum**, mostly at Uncivilization nights in İzmir, and my own tracks go out as **Senst**. There are live sets on synthesizers too, and production in Ableton Live. Guitar came first, keys came later, and drums are a work in progress.

For balance there's distance: a long list of half marathons, two marathons so far, and some very long days on the bike.

This site is a log of those things more than a résumé. If something here is useful to you, or you want to build or play something together, write to me.
service: Evenings and weekends. Delays likely around race season.
